title: Santorini Wedding Packages and What They Include
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: NEW guide (not a refresh). Model: content/posts/greece-wedding-packages (same no-price approach). Covers what Santorini venue packages include and leave out, venue fee versus package versus a planner, and how to compare quotes like for like, from what venues publish about their own packages. NO prices, fees, amounts, percentages or 'from' prices anywhere; 'a fee applies' or 'charged on top' only where a venue says so.

OVERLAP: the Greece packages guide (draft, /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages) flagged 'santorini wedding packages' as an opportunity for /destination-wedding-packages. Recommended split: this guide owns the Santorini package terms; the Greece guide keeps Greece terms; /destination-wedding-packages keeps generic all-inclusive intent. SEO checks rankings for santorini wedding packages and variants (all inclusive, cost, elopement package, packages for 2). Link prominently: /destination-weddings/santorini-wedding-venues (draft, venue detail) and /destination-weddings/santorini-wedding (draft, legal steps and seasons).

Venue facts only from each venue's own official site, read live (package pages, wedding pages, brochures or PDFs the venue publishes). Package inclusions only where the venue states them. The caldera-view rule from the venues guide does NOT apply here; any Santorini venue that hosts weddings and describes its packages can be cited.

AUTHORITY RULE (content-system/brand/voice-guide.md 'Write with authority'): no research talk ('on its own site', 'in its own words', 'does not publish' as our search, page dates as source talk, myths); 'often told' at most once; no hedge stacking; link each source once; no 'best' claims; no best month.

Legal: only a short line (religious, civil, symbolic as venues state them; Smartraveller and Embassy Athens facts as at November 2026; 'check with the Municipality of Thira and the embassy, including any fees'); link /destination-weddings/santorini-wedding for the steps. Nothing implies the Advisor handles legal, church or religious paperwork.

Australian angle: quotes in euros versus AUD as a question to ask; Advisor line from brand facts (quotes in AUD for Australian couples; inclusions confirmed in writing); travel insurance only as a question.

Links: /destination-weddings/santorini-wedding-venues (prominent), /destination-weddings/santorini-wedding, /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages, /destination-wedding-packages (if SEO confirms it is live and relevant), /destinations/europe/greece, /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions (once), /wonderland-concierge, /magazine. UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=santorini-wedding-packages&utm_content=primary|secondary|magnet|closing. Anchor text names 'Wedded Concierge', never 'Wonderland Concierge'. Do not link /7-must-see-santorini-destination-wedding-venues or /venue/rocabella-santorini-hotel-spa.

Speed: Apify web-fetch. 2 parallel batches (A: re-check package and fee pages of venues already sourced, fact_01+; B: other Santorini venues publishing wedding packages, fact_100+), 15 min HARD, reads in one parallel round, scratch folders sp_a, sp_b; practical and legal facts reused from content/posts/santorini-wedding-venues/03-source-pack.json (fact_500-518) as part-5; never retry a declined call.
Images: placeholders only; venue images licensed or press kit with permission; never AI for a venue, destination or wedding.
Do not use 'from first idea to the last dance' or 'last dance'; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; one Advisor line in the body plus the close; no transfer arrangements; no Wedded Privileges.

Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices or amounts; venue names allowed where a venue's package is described, no planner or other vendor names; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
